reason: Assess interval quality after the published evaluation; do not alter its point predictions, original protocol, hypotheses or serving artefacts.
checkpoint_state: best_model_state selected by the original validation rule
preprocessing: reuse the original 532-fit statistics; verify them without changing them

calibration.residual: absolute prediction error in original unannualized sigma7

evaluation.predictions: unchanged saved predictions from each matching frozen predictor

subgroups: realized target level using original fit-only quartile thresholds; retrospective diagnostic, not an observable routing rule

uncertainty.calendar_resampling: circular moving-block bootstrap, fixed q and fitted predictors
uncertainty.scope: marginal intervals conditional on calibration and fitted predictors; not calibration-quantile uncertainty or simultaneous intervals

dependence_limit: Overlapping rolling targets and a chronological calibration period do not establish exchangeability. The finite-sample rank convention does not give a 90% coverage guarantee here.
